name: GW Ranch Waha gas supply pipeline (Pacifico Energy)
monitor_reason: no concrete step for the pipeline itself (air permit covers the power plant); operator and route not named
researcher_notes: A trade news story from datacenterdynamics.com says the GW Ranch project in Pecos County, Texas, includes multiple gas supply connections, among them a 15-mile pipeline to the Waha hub. Pacifico Energy is developing the off-grid campus for a hyperscale data center. The air permit it received covers the power plant, not the pipeline. No source names a pipeline owner or operator, a route, a permit filing for the pipeline, a contract or a construction start. A search for the Texas Railroad Commission pipeline filing found nothing. This stays on the watch list until a concrete step for the pipeline appears, such as a Railroad Commission permit, an operator announcement or a gas supply contract. If it is added later: Fuel Gas, Status proposed, length 15 mi, DataCenter yes, citing the news story. Confidence is low.
